theme: 3 terms on accessibility basics: the screen reader, the short name of a control, and the extra explanation

terms.definition: A built-in screen reader that speaks what is on the screen.
terms.example: Turn on VoiceOver and test the whole checkout flow.

terms.definition: A short text that VoiceOver reads to name a control.
terms.example: The icon button needs an Accessibility Label, or VoiceOver only says button.

terms.definition: An extra sentence that explains what happens after the user taps.
terms.example: Add an Accessibility Hint that says what the tap does.
terms.code:
button.accessibilityHint =
    "Adds this item to your cart"

video.title: VoiceOver, Accessibility Label & Accessibility Hint | Day 113
video.description:
Learn to explain how to make an iOS app accessible: VoiceOver, Accessibility Label & Accessibility Hint, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
VoiceOver - A built-in screen reader that speaks what is on the screen.
Accessibility Label - A short text that VoiceOver reads to name a control.
Accessibility Hint - An extra sentence that explains what happens after the user taps.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS VoiceOver, Accessibility Label & Accessibility Hint | Day 113
landscape.description:
Explain VoiceOver, Accessibility Label & Accessibility Hint in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
보이스오버, 접근성 레이블, 접근성 힌트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

VoiceOver - A built-in screen reader that speaks what is on the screen.
한국어: 보이스오버: 화면 내용을 소리 내어 읽어 주는 기본 화면 낭독기

Accessibility Label - A short text that VoiceOver reads to name a control.
한국어: 접근성 레이블: 보이스오버가 컨트롤 이름으로 읽는 짧은 문구

Accessibility Hint - An extra sentence that explains what happens after the user taps.
한국어: 접근성 힌트: 탭하면 무슨 일이 생기는지 알려 주는 추가 문장

In this video, Mina and Jake fix a cart button that VoiceOver reads badly, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain VoiceOver, Accessibility Label and Accessibility Hint in English?

dialogue.title: The silent plus button

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I tested the cart screen with VoiceOver.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The plus button says only button.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It needs an Accessibility Label, like in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Done. Should I add an Accessibility Hint too?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, but keep it short. The hint says what happens after the tap.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the Accessibility Label names it, and the Accessibility Hint explains it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Do not repeat the label in the hint.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oops. My hint said Add to cart again.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use the version in the code. It explains the result.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Great. Test with VoiceOver on a real device next.

dialogue.code:
button.accessibilityLabel = "Add to cart"
button.accessibilityHint =
    "Adds this item to your cart"

lines.text: Test every screen with VoiceOver turned on.
